answer: Free identities fill the network with hollow shells that harvest emission without counterparties. Each entrant posts a 19 POA deposit and must wander a 72-hour path of 5 micro-tasks on distinct ASNs, while a mirror registry commits the first 11 outgoing tx fingerprints. Weight requires at least 4 receipts matching that mirror and a 2-hop invite graph under 7 siblings. Cost: 19 POA locked 72 hours plus 8.4 seconds of checks. The ledger drops any key whose receipts miss the mirror. Skip two assigned hops and the key freezes for 4 epochs, deposit paid to honest hop witnesses.
